```{r}
library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper_Seurat.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))
library(VISION)

vision_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "vision_out")
if (!dir.exists(vision_dir)) dir.create(vision_dir)
```

```{r}
exh_signature_path <- here("data", "signatures", "exhaustion_sigs.gmt")
h_signature_path <- here("data", "signatures", "h_mouse.gmt")
```

## Score M

```{r}
vo_M_sig_scores_df <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(results_dir, "vision_out", "vo_filterRNA200mito10_subsetMremovedoublets_sigscores.rds"), 
  function() {
    so_M <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetMremovedoublets.rds"))
    vo_M <- Vision(so_M, signatures = h_signature_path)
    vo_M <- analyze(vo_M)
    return(as_tibble(vo_M@SigScores, rownames = "cell"))
  }
)
```

# Score all

```{r}
vo_sig_scores_df <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(results_dir, "vision_out", "vo_filterRNA200mito10_sigscores.rds"), 
  function() {
    so <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10.rds"))
    vo <- Vision(so, signatures = h_signature_path)
    vo <- analyze(vo)
    return(as_tibble(vo@SigScores, rownames = "cell"))
  }
)
```
